payload.content: If a column name in the schema contains a hyphen (-), space, slash (/), or other non-identifier character, you MUST wrap it in backticks (`like-this`) and copy the exact name verbatim from the schema (case-sensitive). Do NOT rename or simplify (e.g. NSLP_Provision_Status is wrong if the schema says `NSLP Provision Status`).

rationale: Targets bird has_special_cols=yes failures (77% fail rate). Pattern: model rewrites quoted/special-char columns into snake_case identifiers, causing column_not_found errors. Predicate: schema has column matching r'[\s\-/]' or wrapped in backticks.
